why: BASE: female-raccoon-001-ipadapter-weight-wording (Josh: off-track). Colour wording is as in the prompt already here (teal fur:1.3, pale cyan, navy blue; negative blocks cream, black, purple). Two other changes from the base: the IP-Adapter reference is baseline.jpg at 0.8 (Josh), and a canny ControlNet (diffusion_pytorch_model_V2) on baseline-highres.png at weight 0.6, steps 0 to 0.6, takes her outlines from the approved sheet so the head and body proportions follow it; the high-res file is used so edges stay sharp at 1536x1024. Prompt, negative, seeds, LoRA, size, steps, CFG and sampler are unchanged. KEY RISK: canny copies the reference layout, which has four figures, colour swatches and a side bust, against the three-view goal. If the outputs show four figures, swatches or a bust, that is the guide copying the layout, not the prompt failing: judge head size, proportions and colour only, and the next job should lower the weight or end step, or Josh should supply a three-view-only guide. If the outputs are three views with a right-sized head, the guide works. Colour differences may partly come from the guide or the changed reference, not only the wording.
